# Brand swap: one brief, two brand profiles

The 01 launch-film brief, claims and scene plan rendered with Magnifito's brand.json on the left and a fictional second brand, Quillfern Studio, on the right: colours, typeface (Geist against Geist Mono), logo and icon colours all come from the brand profile. Both profiles pass a brand check first.

- Type: Brand swap
- Skill: `magnifito-brand`
- Engine: `hyperframes`
- Output: 1920x1080, 15 s, silent
- Video: [`../videos/v02-brand-swap.mp4`](../videos/v02-brand-swap.mp4)

## Recreate it with Claude Code

Install the plugin (see the repository README), open this folder, and give Claude this prompt:

> Use the magnifito-brand skill to show that one brief works for any brand. Take the 01-branded-promo launch film (brief, claims and the four brand-title scenes) and render it twice with HyperFrames: once with Magnifito's brand.json (magnifito/), once with a second, clearly fictional brand, Quillfern Studio (quillfern/): deep teal and amber, Geist Mono Medium from the repository's OFL fonts, a simple fern-quill SVG logo, its own tagline and a quillfern.example address. Check both brand profiles first (schema, WCAG contrast of the text and mark colours, font files, licences and Cyrillic coverage) and keep the reports. Then put the two films side by side with mgvideo multicam and label each half with its brand in Geist (labels.svg).

## Recreate it by hand

From the repository root, one command renders this example exactly as committed:

```sh
npm run showcase -- v02-brand-swap
```

Or run the steps yourself from `showcase/v02-brand-swap/` (after `npm run build && npm link`):

```sh
node brand-check.mjs magnifito work/brand-check-magnifito.json
node brand-check.mjs quillfern work/brand-check-quillfern.json
mgvideo render magnifito --force
node collect-run.mjs magnifito/runs work/magnifito.mp4
mgvideo render quillfern --force
node collect-run.mjs quillfern/runs work/quillfern.mp4
mgvideo multicam work/magnifito.mp4 work/quillfern.mp4 --layout side-by-side -o work/side-by-side.mp4
node rasterize.mjs labels.svg work/labels.png 1920 1080
ffmpeg -i work/side-by-side.mp4 -i work/labels.png -filter_complex "[0:v][1:v]overlay=0:0,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -an -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium work/brand-swap.mp4
```

The finished file is `work/brand-swap.mp4`. The config files in this folder are the inputs.
